meta.note: Voice, mark and neutral colours and the three faces come from the app. The dark theme, turmeric-mark, type scale, spacing, radii, sizes and every component are new in this proposal.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind paper. The palest indigo dip.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Surfaces that hold a document or a form: panels, the list, the transcript, inputs.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells inside paper: drop zones, list group headers, row hover, progress tracks, the reference prefix.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines and panel borders, and the idle transcript rails. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons. At least 3:1 on ground, paper and paper-sunk.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on ground, paper and paper-sunk. Also marks a finished step.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, metadata, timestamps and placeholders on ground, paper and paper-sunk.

tokens.name: practitioner
tokens.usage: Indigo: the practitioner's voice and track, the practitioner's rail, primary buttons, links, the current step. Text on paper, ground and practitioner-tint.

tokens.name: practitioner-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of primary buttons.

tokens.name: practitioner-tint
tokens.usage: Wash behind the current step chip, quiet-button hover, a drop zone with a file over it, the practitioner's recording strip.

tokens.name: on-practitioner
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a practitioner fill (primary buttons, the practitioner play button).

tokens.name: patient
tokens.usage: Green: the patient's voice and track, the patient's rail and label. Text on paper, ground and patient-tint. Never means success.

tokens.name: patient-tint
tokens.usage: Wash behind the patient's recording strip.

tokens.name: on-patient
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a patient fill (the patient play button).

tokens.name: turmeric
tokens.usage: Identity yellow for large fills such as the cover. Not text, not the underline of an uncertain word (use turmeric-mark).

tokens.name: turmeric-mark
tokens.usage: Underline of an uncertain word and the edge of a step that needs checking. At least 3:1 on paper and turmeric-tint.

tokens.name: turmeric-tint
tokens.usage: Wash behind uncertain words, attention chips and notices.

tokens.name: turmeric-ink
tokens.usage: Text on turmeric-tint.

tokens.name: madder
tokens.usage: Something failed or will be destroyed: error text, failed steps, danger buttons. Text on paper, ground and madder-tint.

tokens.name: madder-tint
tokens.usage: Wash behind failure chips and failure notices, danger-button hover.

tokens.name: screen
tokens.usage: Behind live video, in both themes: the call screen and the self view.

tokens.name: on-screen
tokens.usage: Text and marks over video: the recording mark, waiting messages.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name in the header and on sign-in, in practitioner. Nothing else.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: One page title per screen (28px/32px below 560px wide). The only other Eczar on a screen.

styles.name: thesis
styles.sample: Turn a consultation's two audio tracks into a transcript you can check and correct.
styles.usage: The single statement on the sign-in screen.

styles.name: transcript
styles.sample: About four in the morning. Then I lie awake until six.
styles.usage: What was said, in a transcript turn. Longer lines and leading for long reading.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Everything else that is read: explanations, notices, inputs.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, button text, step names.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: wav, mp3, m4a, flac, ogg or webm, up to 50 MB
styles.usage: Hints, metadata, chips, legends. Never below 14px.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Times, durations and patient references, with tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its word; tight label stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to its input; between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between buttons; inside list rows and turns.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones; between fields; panel padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; between panels on a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page top padding; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between the sign-in statement and its form.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-paper
tokens.usage: Panels, the list, notices, checkboxes: paper is nearly square.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, drop zones.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips, progress bars, round play buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-paper
tokens.usage: Panels and the sign-in card, together with a rule border. The only shadow on a page.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of buttons, inputs and selects; the touch target.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the header and page content.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length of transcript text and explanations.
